title: Recorded measurements
description: Replay fixture measurements or a selected JSON array of numbers. No device required.

source.build: Provided by @opendevicedb/components/host; no contributor JavaScript is evaluated as a host service.

behavior: Replays 10, 20, 30, 20, 10, or a user-selected array of 1–4096 finite numbers. Backpressure pauses production. Source timestamps and session IDs are assigned by the host; no data is uploaded.
